Game Overview

Zombie Epidemic is a first-person shooter title where navigate a post-apocalyptic city teeming with zombies in this thrilling first-person shooter. As an elite soldier, battle relentless undead hordes, manage resources, and climb the leaderboard. Choose between an intense campaign or endless survival mode, overcoming escalating challenges to secure humanity's future. Can you master the chaos?
